name: Strumenti
description: Gli strumenti del laboratorio di validazione.

terms.definition: An instrument that shows how a voltage changes over time.
terms.example: I captured the glitch on the oscilloscope.

terms.definition: The tip you connect to the circuit to measure a signal.
terms.example: Use a short ground spring on the probe.

terms.definition: An instrument that records many digital signals at the same time.
terms.example: We decoded the SPI bus with the logic analyzer.

terms.definition: A device that provides a stable voltage or current to the board.
terms.example: Set the power supply to 3.3 volts with a 500 milliamp limit.

terms.definition: An instrument that can force a voltage or current and measure at the same time.
terms.example: We measured the leakage current with the SMU.

terms.definition: A handheld instrument to measure voltage, current and resistance.
terms.example: Check the continuity with the multimeter.

terms.definition: An instrument that produces test signals, like sine or square waves.
terms.example: The signal generator injects a 1 kilohertz sine wave.

terms.definition: A box that keeps the board at a controlled temperature and humidity.
terms.example: We tested the board from minus forty to one hundred twenty-five degrees in the climatic chamber.

terms.definition: An instrument that shows the signal power at each frequency.
terms.example: The spectrum analyzer showed a spur at 48 megahertz.

terms.definition: An instrument that measures how a circuit reflects and transmits high-frequency signals.
terms.example: We checked the antenna matching with the network analyzer.

terms.definition: A probe that measures current without breaking the circuit.
terms.example: The current probe showed a spike at power-up.

terms.definition: A probe that measures the voltage between two points, neither of them ground.
terms.example: Use a differential probe on the USB data lines.

terms.definition: A simple signal generator for standard waveforms.
terms.example: The function generator drives the external clock input.

terms.definition: An instrument that draws a programmable current from a power source.
terms.example: We tested the regulator with an electronic load.

terms.definition: A camera that shows the temperature of every point on the board.
terms.example: The thermal camera found a hot spot near the regulator.

terms.definition: The hot tool used to melt solder and connect components.
terms.example: I fixed the broken pin with the soldering iron.
terms.note: iron si legge «àiern»: la r quasi non si sente.

terms.definition: A tool that blows hot air to solder or remove small chips.
terms.example: We replaced the QFN package with the hot air station.

terms.definition: An instrument that makes very small things look bigger.
terms.example: I inspected the solder joints under the microscope.

terms.definition: A strap that connects you to ground to avoid electrostatic discharge.
terms.example: Always wear the ESD wrist strap when you touch the board.

terms.definition: A ready-made board to test a chip and its features.
terms.example: We started with the vendor's evaluation board.

terms.definition: The adapter that connects the PC to the chip's debug port.
terms.example: Connect the debug probe to the SWD header.

terms.definition: A board with holes to build circuits without soldering.
terms.example: I built a quick prototype on a breadboard.

terms.definition: A short wire used to connect two points.
terms.example: Add a jumper wire between the two test points.

terms.definition: A mechanical setup that holds the board and connects it to the instruments.
terms.example: The test fixture has spring pins for every test point.

terms.definition: A temperature sensor made of two different metals.
terms.example: We glued a thermocouple on top of the package.

terms.definition: A device that records measurements over a long time.
terms.example: The data logger recorded the temperature every second.

terms.definition: An instrument that measures the frequency of a signal very accurately.
terms.example: The frequency counter read 32.768 kilohertz.

terms.definition: An instrument that measures inductance, capacitance and resistance.
terms.example: We checked the capacitor value with the LCR meter.

terms.definition: The table in the lab where you set up a test.
terms.example: The new samples are on my bench.

terms.definition: A holder that lets you change the chip without soldering.
terms.example: We use a test socket to swap the samples quickly.

terms.definition: A wire, or group of wires, with connectors.
terms.example: Use a shorter cable to reduce the noise.

terms.definition: An instrument that sends data and counts the wrong bits at the receiver.
terms.example: The bit error rate tester ran for one hour without errors.
